items.t: Thanksgiving storm floods US and cuts power to a million
items.d: Storms on both coasts brought gales, heavy rain and flooding as the holiday weekend began, leaving almost a million customers without power and snarling flights.

items.t: US proposes new tariffs on 14 partners including China and EU
items.d: Washington unveiled fresh Section 301 levies on many of its biggest trading partners, adding to trade tensions and helping unsettle global markets this week.

items.t: Ukraine says it hit five Russian jets at key airfield
items.d: Kyiv says a strike on Savasleyka airbase, used for hypersonic missile and glide-bomb attacks, damaged five military aircraft as US-led peace efforts stall.

items.t: Hong Kong families still seek justice a year after Tai Po fire
items.d: A year after the Wang Fuk Court blaze killed 168 people during renovation works, residents marked the anniversary while many families await accountability.

items.t: Mexico captures FBI most-wanted drug lord 'El Chapo Isidro'
items.d: Fausto Isidro Meza Flores was detained after a gunfight; soldiers then came under attack as they restored order, with eight suspects arrested.

items.t: Solomon Islands drops China security pact for Australian treaty
items.d: Prime Minister Matthew Wale ended the controversial 2022 deal with Beijing, a notable shift in Pacific influence towards Canberra.

items.t: New Zealand's ruling bloc falls one seat short of majority
items.d: Final results leave the National-led coalition needing extra support to govern, opening a period of uncertainty in Wellington.

items.t: Asian stocks whipsaw after Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia
items.d: Markets heavily exposed to Nvidia's supply chain swung sharply after Huang was reinstated as chief executive days after resigning.

items.t: Moody's cuts Nvidia outlook to stable over leadership turmoil
items.d: Moody's trimmed its outlook and S&P flagged governance concerns, a reminder that the AI boom's biggest company carries new risks.

items.t: Hong Kong exports rise in October on AI electronics demand
items.d: Both exports and imports grew year on year, driven by strong shipments of AI-related electronic components.

items.t: Nvidia pauses server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries
items.d: Nvidia reportedly told partners to halt shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia after tighter US export rules aimed at China.

items.t: US chip curbs slow China's next AI models
items.d: Reuters reports Z.AI's next flagship is delayed and Moonshot expects longer gaps between releases if it loses overseas computing power.

items.t: Microsoft exposes state hackers' AI attack framework 'ARTEX'
items.d: Microsoft says government-backed hackers use ARTEX to hand attack tasks to specialised AI agents, and recommends decoy-based defences.

items.t: Switzerland reports five cyberattacks run by AI agents
items.d: The Swiss cybersecurity office says AI agents were used against businesses and critical infrastructure, a sign automated hacking is now real.

items.t: EU may vote on approving Tesla's assisted driving on 15 Dec
items.d: A draft Commission agenda lists a vote that could authorise Tesla's driver-assistance system across the bloc.

items.t: Canada lifts AI compute fund to C$1 billion
items.d: Ottawa added C$700m and will cover up to 80% of costs bought from qualifying Canadian sovereign cloud providers.

items.t: Cheaper twice-yearly HIV prevention jab reaches Africa
items.d: Lenacapavir, nearly 100% effective at preventing infection, is arriving at lower cost, raising hopes for millions at risk.

items.t: Hidden brine lakes found a mile beneath the Red Sea
items.d: Scientists mapped salty, oxygen-free pools on the deep seabed that preserve records of past climate and host unusual microbes.

items.t: Euclid space telescope spots its first unknown comet
items.d: The European mission, built to map dark matter, picked up a previously unseen comet in its survey images.

items.t: Net migration at 77,000; Burnham says it's under control
items.d: Annual net migration hit its lowest level this century outside Covid, and the prime minister said numbers are now sufficiently controlled.

items.t: UK to pay EU 'participation' fee under new deals
items.d: Newly published legal texts reveal Britain will contribute to EU running costs, with a 10-year termination clause in the treaty.

items.t: Nearly 100 Labour MPs oppose Rosebank oil field
items.d: Ministerial aides are among those urging Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh to reject drilling west of Shetland ahead of her decision.

items.t: 感恩節風暴吹襲美國 近百萬戶停電
items.d: 風暴同時吹襲美國東西岸，帶來強風、暴雨及水浸，正值假期周末開始，近百萬用戶停電，航班大受影響。

items.t: 美國擬向中國及歐盟等14個貿易夥伴加徵關稅
items.d: 美國公布新一輪「301條款」關稅，涉及多個最大貿易夥伴，加劇貿易緊張，本周亦令環球股市波動。

items.t: 烏克蘭稱襲擊俄軍機場 擊中五架戰機
items.d: 基輔指襲擊薩瓦斯列伊卡空軍基地，擊中五架軍機；該基地用作發射高超音速導彈及滑翔炸彈。美國主導的和談仍陷僵局。

items.t: 大埔宏福苑火災一周年 家屬仍待公義
items.d: 宏福苑維修期間發生大火、造成168人死亡一年後，居民及市民悼念遇難者，不少家屬仍在等待問責。

items.t: 墨西哥拘捕聯邦調查局頭號通緝毒梟
items.d: 毒梟梅薩·弗洛雷斯在槍戰後被捕；其後軍人恢復秩序時遭襲擊，當局拘捕八名疑犯。

items.t: 所羅門群島棄中國安全協議 改與澳洲簽約
items.d: 總理韋爾終止2022年與北京簽訂、具爭議的安全協議，改與澳洲訂約，顯示太平洋影響力向坎培拉傾斜。

items.t: 新西蘭執政聯盟國會議席差一席過半
items.d: 最終點票結果顯示國家黨領導的聯盟未能取得多數，需爭取額外支持才能執政，政局不明朗。

items.t: 黃仁勳重返Nvidia 亞洲股市大起大落
items.d: 黃仁勳辭職數日後獲復任行政總裁，與Nvidia供應鏈關係密切的亞洲股市大幅波動。

items.t: 穆迪下調Nvidia評級展望至「穩定」
items.d: 穆迪因管理層風波下調Nvidia展望，標普亦關注其管治，反映AI熱潮龍頭企業面對新風險。

items.t: AI電子產品需求帶動 香港10月出口上升
items.d: 受AI相關電子產品付運強勁帶動，香港10月出口及進口均按年上升。

items.t: Nvidia暫停向東南亞四國付運伺服器
items.d: 據報Nvidia因美國收緊針對中國的出口管制，要求夥伴暫停向馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國及印尼付運伺服器。

items.t: 美國晶片管制拖慢中國AI新模型
items.d: 路透社報道，智譜Z.AI下一代旗艦模型延遲推出；月之暗面預計若失去海外算力，新模型推出間隔將拉長。

items.t: Microsoft揭國家級黑客AI攻擊框架ARTEX
items.d: Microsoft指有政府背景的黑客利用ARTEX，把攻擊任務分派給專門AI代理，建議以誘餌系統防禦。

items.t: 瑞士通報五宗AI代理網絡攻擊
items.d: 瑞士網絡安全辦公室表示，有人利用AI代理攻擊企業及關鍵基建，顯示自動化黑客攻擊已成現實。

items.t: 歐盟或於12月15日表決批准Tesla輔助駕駛
items.d: 歐盟委員會議程草案顯示，將表決是否在全歐盟批准Tesla的駕駛輔助系統。

items.t: 加拿大AI算力基金增至10億加元
items.d: 加國政府額外注資7億加元，向合資格本土主權雲端供應商購買算力，最多資助八成費用。

items.t: 平價半年一針愛滋病預防針抵達非洲
items.d: 預防感染效用近百分百的長效針劑Lenacapavir以較低價格引入非洲，為數以百萬計高危人士帶來希望。

items.t: 紅海海底逾千米發現隱藏鹵水湖
items.d: 科學家在深海海床發現高鹽、缺氧的水池，保存過去氣候紀錄，並有罕見微生物棲息。

items.t: 歐幾里得太空望遠鏡首次發現新彗星
items.d: 這部用作繪製暗物質分佈的歐洲望遠鏡，在巡天影像中發現一顆前所未見的彗星。

items.t: 淨移民跌至7.7萬 賓咸稱已受控
items.d: 全年淨移民人數創本世紀（疫情除外）新低，首相賓咸表示移民數字已「充分受控」。

items.t: 英國將按新協議向歐盟繳付「參與費」
items.d: 新公布的法律文件顯示，英國須分擔歐盟部分營運開支，條約設有十年終止條款。

items.t: 近百名工黨議員反對Rosebank油田
items.d: 包括多名部長助理在內的工黨議員，促請能源大臣在作決定前否決設得蘭以西的鑽油計劃。
